verdicts.reason: Both banners put the left-column copy (tagline, URL) at an illegible size. Both shrink the RSVP CTA to a pill identical to the tag pills, so it no longer stands out, and both leave the broken partner-asset placeholder in the pill row. A keeps all four pills together as one tidy group under the date, though its headline is fairly small for a banner. B gives the headline more weight but strands the TASTINGS pill on its own beside the headline at a tiny size and squeezes the date into small text, so B looks more scattered and less intentional than A.
